text: The equivalence principle holds only locally: in a sufficiently small freely falling frame gravity disappears, but over an extended region tidal forces reveal genuine spacetime curvature that cannot be transformed away by any choice of frame.
explanation: This is true. In a small enough free-fall frame there exist normal coordinates with g_μν(p) = η_μν and Γ^ρ_μν(p) = 0, so locally physics is that of special relativity. Over a finite region the second derivatives of the metric — the Riemann curvature — produce tidal (differential) accelerations that no change of frame can remove, which is the unmistakable signature of real gravity versus a mere accelerated frame.
